nodes.name: Receive Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /lead-intake. Header-token auth (x-webhook-token) => bad/missing token returns 401 before the workflow runs. responseMode=onReceived returns 200 {status:received} immediately so the lead source never waits on processing (spec §5.01).

nodes.name: Validate Required Fields
nodes.notes: Entry validation (spec §8.2). Requires: source, at least one of phone/email, and E.164 phone when a phone is given. Flattens body -> top-level fields for downstream expressions.

nodes.name: Route Valid vs Malformed
nodes.notes: TRUE => valid, continue pipeline. FALSE => malformed, log and exit. Malformed never hits the happy path (spec §8.2).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: '01 - Lead Intake', execution_id: $execution.id, status: 'failed', step_name: 'validate', error_message: $json._reason, metadata: { source: $json.source, has_phone: !!$json.phone, has_email: !!$json.email } }) }}

nodes.name: Log Malformed Lead
nodes.notes: Observability: records the malformed lead in run_logs (status=failed) then the branch ends. onError=continue so a logging outage never masks the real reject decision.

nodes.name: Normalize Dedup Input
nodes.notes: Normalizes phone (digits only) + email (lowercase/trim) so cosmetic differences don't defeat dedup. Builds the source string the Crypto node hashes. Also sets a coarse country_code from the dial prefix.

nodes.name: Compute Dedup Key
nodes.notes: dedup_key = SHA256(phone_norm | email_norm | source), hex. Deterministic: same lead+source => same key => UNIQUE constraint enforces idempotency (spec §8.3). Different source => different key (distinct leads).

nodes.name: Check Duplicate Against Supabase
nodes.notes: 72h lookback dedup query. fullResponse+neverError => body is the array of matches (empty = fresh). onError=continue so a check failure FAILS SAFE toward insert (the UNIQUE constraint is the real guard). 72h window = same lead later is a new inquiry (spec decision 8).

nodes.name: Route If Duplicate
nodes.notes: TRUE => an active lead with this dedup_key exists within 72h => update existing + log, do NOT insert. FALSE => fresh lead, continue to classification.

nodes.name: Build Language Request
nodes.notes: Builds the Haiku language-detection request (prompts/language-detector.md v1) in JS so the multi-line system prompt stays readable. Passes it to the HTTP node as anthropic_body.

nodes.name: Detect Language (Haiku)
nodes.notes: Haiku 4.5 language detection. onError=continue + alwaysOutputData => on failure the item still flows; Assemble Lead Row falls back to the country heuristic. 15s timeout, 2 retries. Cheap (~$0.0003/call).

nodes.name: Build Intent Request
nodes.notes: Builds the Haiku intent-classification request (prompts/intent-classifier.md v1). Pulls lead fields from Compute Dedup Key (the HTTP nodes overwrite $json with their own response).

nodes.name: Classify Intent (Haiku)
nodes.notes: Haiku 4.5 intent classification. 15s timeout, 3 retries. onError=continue => Assemble Lead Row defaults intent to 'medium' and marks the run 'partial' rather than dropping the lead (spec §8.1 degraded path).

nodes.name: Assemble Lead Row
nodes.notes: Merges lead data + parsed AI results into the exact leads-row shape. Language falls back to a country heuristic; intent falls back to 'medium' (marking the run partial). No throw path here — always produces an insertable row.

nodes.name: Insert Lead Into Supabase
nodes.notes: Inserts the lead. return=representation => body is [ {row} ] with id. neverError => a 409 unique_violation (race) comes back as data, not a throw, and Route Insert Result sends it to the Update path (spec §8.3 idempotency).

nodes.name: Route Insert Result
nodes.notes: TRUE => insert returned a new row id => log success. FALSE => conflict/failure => treat as duplicate race, update existing + log.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: '01 - Lead Intake', execution_id: $execution.id, lead_id: $json.body[0].id, status: ($('Assemble Lead Row').item.json._intent_degraded ? 'partial' : 'success'), step_name: 'insert_lead', metadata: { intent: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json.row.intent_classification, language: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json.row.language, language_source: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json._language_source, country_code: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json.row.country_code, source: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json.row.source, message: $('Compute Dedup Key').item.json.message } }) }}

nodes.name: Log Run Success
nodes.notes: Terminal success log. status=partial when the intent call degraded to the 'medium' fallback, else success. Captures the AI outputs for the observability trail (spec §8.4).

nodes.name: Update Existing Lead
nodes.notes: Duplicate within 72h (or insert race): touch updated_at on the existing row instead of inserting a second one. Makes the re-inquiry visible without duplicating the lead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: '01 - Lead Intake', execution_id: $execution.id, status: 'success', step_name: 'dedup', metadata: { dedup_key: $('Compute Dedup Key').item.json.dedup_key, note: 'duplicate within 72h window — updated existing lead, no new row' } }) }}

nodes.name: Log Duplicate
nodes.notes: Terminal dedup log. Records that a duplicate was collapsed onto the existing lead (spec §8.3/8.4).

nodes.name: Route By Intent
nodes.notes: high/medium => send WhatsApp acknowledgment. low (nurture, no message) / junk (mark + exit) => straight to Log Run Success, no send (spec §5.01).

nodes.name: Get Send Config
nodes.notes: Fetch the lead country send-window config (timezone, weekend_days, quiet hours, respect_prayer_times). fullResponse+neverError => body is the row array (empty if country unseeded); Resolve Send Context defaults to AE if missing.

nodes.name: Resolve Send Context
nodes.notes: Send-window math in the lead local timezone (Luxon, bundled — no npm). Reads send_windows row (or AE default). Computes weekend/quiet-hours and the next valid 08:00 open; send_window_resume = now when already in-window. Also derives whatsapp_number (E.164) and per-country prayer city/method. Deviation: timezone via send_windows lookup, not libphonenumber (see decisions.md).

nodes.name: Wait For Send Window
nodes.notes: Suspends until the country send-window opens (weekend / 22:00-08:00 quiet hours). A past/now time resumes immediately. Safe to suspend: the webhook already returned 200 (responseMode onReceived).

nodes.name: Get Prayer Times
nodes.notes: Aladhan prayer timings for the lead city + today (fetched AFTER the send-window wait so the date is correct). Free, no auth. neverError + onError=continue => an outage skips the prayer check and never blocks the send (spec §7).

nodes.name: Resolve Prayer Delay
nodes.notes: If within 15 min of any of the 5 prayers (and the country respects prayer times), delay the send 30 min. LB is skipped_country (religiously mixed, decisions.md). API outage => prayer_check='unavailable', no delay, run marked partial downstream.

nodes.name: Wait For Prayer
nodes.notes: Suspends 30 min when the send lands inside a prayer window; otherwise resumes immediately (prayer_resume = now).

nodes.name: Build Acknowledgment Request
nodes.notes: Builds the Sonnet 5 acknowledgment request (prompts/acknowledgment-generator.md v1). Pulls lead fields from Compute Dedup Key and language from Assemble Lead Row (HTTP/Wait nodes overwrite $json).

nodes.name: Generate Acknowledgment (Sonnet)
nodes.notes: Sonnet 5 personalized acknowledgment. 20s timeout, 2 retries. onError=continue => Parse Acknowledgment falls back to a static bilingual template and marks the run partial rather than sending nothing (better an extra message than a dropped lead).

nodes.name: Parse Acknowledgment
nodes.notes: Extracts the plain WhatsApp text from Sonnet. Degraded path: failed/empty call => static bilingual template (ar/fr/en) so we always acknowledge. Enforces <=500 chars for Twilio.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Acknowledgment (Twilio)
nodes.notes: Sends the acknowledgment over the Twilio WhatsApp sandbox (shared from +14155238886; toWhatsapp adds the whatsapp: prefix). Continue-On-Fail (PLAN 3.4): a Twilio outage is logged partial and the lead still moves to qualifying — never a silent drop. Returns the message sid.

nodes.name: Update Lead To Qualifying

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'qualifying', whatsapp_number: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.whatsapp_number, timezone: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.timezone }) }}

nodes.notes: Moves the lead new -> qualifying after the first outbound and persists whatsapp_number + timezone (set in M3). Runs even if Twilio failed, so a delivery outage does not strand the lead in 'new'.

nodes.name: Log Outbound Message

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('Insert Lead Into Supabase').item.json.body[0].id, direction: 'outbound', channel: 'whatsapp', message: $('Parse Acknowledgment').item.json.ack_message, twilio_message_id: ($('Send WhatsApp Acknowledgment (Twilio)').item.json.sid || null), turn_number: 1 }) }}

nodes.notes: One conversations row per outbound (turn_number=1). Stores the Twilio sid (null if the send degraded) for the observability trail and later reply-handler matching (M4).

nodes.name: Log Outbound Run Success

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: '01 - Lead Intake', execution_id: $execution.id, lead_id: $('Insert Lead Into Supabase').item.json.body[0].id, status: ( $('Parse Acknowledgment').item.json.ack_degraded || !$('Send WhatsApp Acknowledgment (Twilio)').item.json.sid || $('Resolve Prayer Delay').item.json.prayer_check === 'unavailable' ) ? 'partial' : 'success', step_name: 'send_acknowledgment', metadata: { intent: $('Assemble Lead Row').item.json.row.intent_classification, language: $('Parse Acknowledgment').item.json.language, country_code: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.country_code, whatsapp_number: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.whatsapp_number, twilio_sid: ($('Send WhatsApp Acknowledgment (Twilio)').item.json.sid || null), ack_degraded: $('Parse Acknowledgment').item.json.ack_degraded, send_window_delayed: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.send_window_delayed, send_window_resume: $('Resolve Send Context').item.json.send_window_resume, prayer_check: $('Resolve Prayer Delay').item.json.prayer_check, prayer_delayed: $('Resolve Prayer Delay').item.json.prayer_delayed } }) }}

nodes.notes: Terminal outbound log. status=partial when the Sonnet ack degraded OR Twilio failed OR the prayer check was unavailable; else success. Metadata captures the send-window/prayer decisions and the Twilio sid (spec §8.4).
